coverage: Rechecked all four run 1 bugs with the run 1 steps (see run1_recheck): all fixed
Reload on Results with a place's details open (normal route, level_01): back to Title, no stars, pending page kept
Reload 100 ms after Recommend (normal route, level_01): 3 stars saved, level_02 unlocked, friends still unannounced, pending page kept; replay shows Liam, Cyrus and page cards in order
Fail with a pending page, reload, then win: no cards on the fail, all three cards on the win, then none on a further replay
'See friends' on Liam's card goes to Friends; Esc from there goes to the map. Cyrus and the page stay pending (not lost)
Reload with the Reset progress check open: nothing reset. Reset itself clears every key, including the new lets-eat-pending-pages-v1 and the ending flag
localStorage.clear() mid-chat: the chat carries on without errors; after reload the chapter card shows again
Browser Back from the Chat: leaves the game (no history), nothing breaks
Two tabs in one context: tab B clears level_01 and sees Liam's card; tab A then clears level_01 and gets Cyrus's card (no double announce, page stays pending until a card shows)
Music button volume panel by keyboard, then reload: volume kept
5 minutes idle on the Outcome after the unlock cards: nothing frozen, one music track (it moved on to the next track), Next level → still works
Corrupt saved data: every lets-eat-* key set to bad JSON, a string, an array, a wrong-type object, null and a number, then reload and play level_01 (found QT-05, QT-06)

bugs.title: A non-object 'venues' save crashes the Results screen: 'Find a place' leaves the player on a frozen Chat
bugs.where: Chat → Results, any level (seen on level_01)
steps: Set localStorage 'lets-eat-venues-v1' to a JSON string or number, e.g. "a string" or 42 (a hand-edited or damaged save)
Reload, Start, open level_01, press A to show the whole chat, then press Enter (Find a place)
bugs.expected: The game ignores the bad value (as it does for unreadable JSON, null, or arrays) and opens the Results list
bugs.actual: Page error "Cannot create property 'campus_noodle_nook' on string 'a string'". No scene stays running. The last Chat frame stays on screen with 'Find a place' highlighted and nothing responds. A reload gives the same result, so the player cannot reach any Results screen until they use Reset progress or clear the site's data. loadVisits() in src/ui/visitStore.js returns any truthy parsed value without checking that it is an object. Rated minor only because the save has to be damaged first; the effect is a blocker
bugs.frequency: every time (4 of 4: "a string" and 42, both in the all-keys run and with only this key set)
errors: pageerror: Cannot create property 'campus_noodle_nook' on string 'a string'
pageerror: Cannot create property 'campus_noodle_nook' on number '42'

bugs.title: A non-object 'scrapbook' save shows 'SCRAPBOOK 8/5' on the map and crashes the chat at a callback line
steps: Set localStorage 'lets-eat-scrapbook-v1' to "a string" (or to an array such as [1,2,{}])
Reload, Start: look at the Scrapbook button on the map
Open level_01 and let the chat reach Liam's 'the satay incident' line (or press A), then press Enter
bugs.expected: The bad value is ignored: SCRAPBOOK 0/5, and the page unlocks normally
bugs.actual: The map button reads 'SCRAPBOOK 8/5' (the string's 8 characters are counted as pages; an array of 3 gives 3/5). Reading the callback line throws "Cannot use 'in' operator to search for 'satay_incident' in a string", and Find a place then does not open Results (scene stays Chat, player stuck). loadPages() in src/ui/scrapbookStore.js, like loadVisits(), accepts any truthy value. The friends-announced and pending-pages stores already check Array.isArray, and a bad pending-pages value is handled fine
bugs.frequency: every time (2 of 2 for the count, 1 of 1 for the chat crash with only this key set)
errors: pageerror: Cannot use 'in' operator to search for 'satay_incident' in a string

not_bugs: Every reload returns to Title (or to the dev-shortcut scene in the URL when one was used), with stars, pages and venues intact; none gained without a win

Unreadable JSON, null, arrays or numbers in progress, settings, music volume, friends-announced, pending-pages, chapter-intros, opened and how-to-play are ignored without errors. A progress value of 99 is clamped to 3 stars
Pending scrapbook pages are held back after a fail and shown on the next win, by design (WA-02 comment in OutcomeScene)
'See friends' from an unlock card leaves the Outcome, and the remaining queued cards wait for the next cleared Outcome. Nothing is lost, it is only deferred
The Reset progress check has Cancel focused first, and a reload while it is open resets nothing
A second tab running in the background animates slowly (the browser throttles it), so its unlock card fills in late. That is a test artifact, not a game bug
The ?scene=Scrapbook / Friends / Options dev shortcuts don't open those screens; only Chat, Results, Outcome and Ending are documented
feedback: All four run 1 problems are gone: refreshing no longer costs any celebration card or the ending. The only way I could still break the game was with damaged saved data, which freezes the game instead of being ignored.
